C0882.title: Professional traffic-diversion team sentenced for using multi-instance software to log into thousands of accounts simultaneously
C0882.summary: Starting in 2019, Xue and others formed a traffic-diversion team that used multi-instance login software and cloud-controlled devices to simultaneously access thousands of self-media platform accounts. They mass-distributed promotional messages for counterfeit luxury goods, employing automated methods to batch-login accounts for illegal traffic generation, resulting in illicit profits of hundreds

references.title: Logging into Thousands of Accounts Simultaneously to Push Counterfeit Luxury Product Info, Professional Traffic Diversion Team Sentenced
